item.title: AstraZeneca Daiichi Datroway FDA Approval
item.description:
• Summary: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo received FDA approval for Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan), a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate. The approval covers treatment of certain advanced cancers, based on pivotal trial data demonstrating improved outcomes in patients with limited options. This marks the third approved indication for the drug, representing a major milestone in targeted cancer therapy.
  • MoAs: Antibody-drug conjugate targeting TROP2 on cancer cells, delivering a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload (deruxtecan) to induce DNA damage and cell death.
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
